text:
Clara: Quick kickoff  Windfall marketplace listing + joint integration webinar targeted for Sep 13. Need a tight ops playbook: inbound lead routing, UTMs, nightly partner drop, benchmark snippet for blog, and copy for co-branded nurture. Who can own what?
Dev: I'll own tracking + UTMs. Proposed canonical params: utm_source=windfall_market, utm_campaign=WIND-LAUNCH-0913, utm_medium=marketplace. Add hidden field partner=windfall and campaign_code=WIND-0913 on all forms.
Hector: For partner delivery, they prefer webhook but accept nightly SFTP (PGP). Ask: do we have DPA in place? If not, plan SFTP + daily CSV. Also they want role and lead_score in payload.
Maya: Webinar plan: 10m intros, 20m product + integration demo, 15m live Q&A, 5m next steps. We need speaker bios, 3 demo scripts (happy path, edge case, performance trick), and a dry run on 9/7.
Ivy: Messaging / benchmark angle: show two short scenarios in the blog: baseline single-node latencies vs Redwood+Windfall with batching + KV cache. Short methodology: same 40 prompt seed, 10 warmups, median p50/p95, and $/1k tokens. Keep the narrative ~120 words and include a link to reproducible scripts.
Clara: Good. Routing matrix (draft):
- partner_opt_in=true AND role in (Engineer, Integrations, DevRel) -> Partner SDR queue (webhook if DPA else nightly CSV)
- lead_score >= 75 OR enterprise_domain -> Redwood AE immediate notify + create SFDC opportunity placeholder (no automatic ownership transfer)
- webinar_registered + attended -> add +25 to lead_score; if new score >= 75 then AE handoff
- all others -> co-branded nurture (dev-focused vs product-focused cadence)
Dev: CSV nightly schema we should send (header):
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,region,role,lead_score,partner_opt_in,utm_source,utm_campaign,hs_contact_id,sfdc_contact_id,consent_timestamp,notes
```
Hector: Add `first_touch_channel` and `sandbox_request` fields. Partner asked for first_touch attribution so they can prioritize marketplace-first leads. Also we need to HMAC-sign webhook payloads for security.
Ivy: Benchmark details: include a tiny table image with p50/p95 and $/1k tokens. I'll mock in Figma. Also draft the human-facing blurb: methodology + headline result + link to reproduce.
Clara: Opt-in copy must match legal text. Use: "I consent to Redwood sharing my contact info with Windfall for follow-up about this integration." default unchecked. Hector, please confirm legal copy with security/legal.
Hector: Will confirm. For SFTP, I'll provision PGP keys and upload sample `windfall-sample-nightly.csv` to shared folder. ETA 8/28.
Dev: Campaign QA checklist: 1) all landing links include UTMs, 2) hidden fields present, 3) HubSpot workflows map to HS lists, 4) Marketo/SFDC sync tested, 5) nightly CSV generated and sample matches schema. I'll add screenshots to the tracking doc.
Maya: CTAs on landing: primary = Register for webinar, secondary = Try integration sandbox (dev), tertiary = Request enterprise POC. Ads to A/B test headlines: A) "Ship inference integrations faster with Redwood + Windfall" B) "Lower inference latency and cost for product teams  Redwood + Windfall". We'll test by channel.
Ivy: For the blog micro-benchmark copy (draft): "In a small two-scenario benchmark, we measured median latencies and token costs using the same 40-prompt set across identical hardware. Result: Redwood+Windfall routing with KV-caching reduced median latency by ~35% and lowered cost per 1k tokens by ~22% versus a single-node baseline. Repro scripts and raw numbers are available in the repo." (I'll shorten as needed for publish).
Clara: Assignments + due dates: Dev = UTMs + tracking doc + HubSpot flows (due 8/25), Hector = partner delivery spec + PGP keys + sample CSV (due 8/28), Maya = webinar run-of-show + demo scripts + dry run scheduling (due 9/7), Ivy = benchmark visuals + blog blurb + reproducible link (due 9/1). I'll own co-branded nurture copy and partner comms.
Hector: Security note: webhook payloads to include x-redwood-hmac and use SHA256; rotate webhook secret quarterly. I'll include sample payload in spec.
Dev: I'll create Marketo smart lists and a Segment event mapping: event = "marketplace_signup" with props partner, campaign_code, sandbox_request, partner_opt_in.
Maya: Dry run with partner scheduled 9/7 10:00am PT. ops-bot: Event created: "Windfall launch ops dry run" 2024-09-07 10:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/windfall-dryrun
ops-bot: Created calendar: "Windfall launch - final sync" 2024-09-11 9:00am PT -> https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/windfall-final-sync
Clara: Final asks before dry run: drop HubSpot workflow screenshots, sample nightly CSV, and the benchmark mock into the tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/windfall-launch. Also lock landing copy and legal opt-in. :rocket:
